literal_native_evidence.952-980:
We now prove statement \eqref{eq:annoyingintegrallimit}. We~will use bounds \eqref{Stirlingbound} and \eqref{eq:boundc1} as well as\vspace*{-3pt}
\[
\frac1{3} \cc{\left(\sfrac{a}{n}\right)}\leq C(a,b)\leq 3 \cc{(\sfrac{a}{n})},
\]
for $a+b=n-1$. As with Proposition \ref{prop:generalintegrallimit}, it~is sufficient to only consider\vspace*{-3pt}
\[
\sqrt{n}\sum_{a=2}^{\lfloor n/2 \rfloor}P(a,b)\Bigl(C(a,b)^{\alpha+1}\Bigl(\frac{a+1}{n+1}\Bigr)^{-\beta+\veps}+C(b,a)^{\alpha+1}\Bigl(\frac{b+1}{n+1}\Bigr)^{-\beta+\veps}-1\Bigr).
\]
This sum is equal to $\int_0^{1/2} g_n(x)\mathrm{d}x$, where\vspace*{-3pt}
\[
g_n(x)= n^{3/2}P(a,b)\Bigl(C(a,b)^{\alpha+1}\Bigl(\frac{a+1}{n+1}\Bigr)^{-\beta+\veps}+C(b,a)^{\alpha+1}\Bigl(\frac{b+1}{n+1}\Bigr)^{-\beta+\veps}-1\Bigr)
\]
if $x\in[\frac{a-1}{n},\frac{a}{n})$ with $a\in \{2,\ldots,\lfloor n/2 \rfloor\}$, and $g_n(x)=0$ otherwise. It~is readily checked that $g_n(x)$ converges pointwise towards\vspace*{-3pt}
\[
\frac{1}{4\sqrt{\pi}}\, \pp(x)\bigl(\ff(x)^{\alpha+1} x^{-\beta+\veps}+\ff(1-x)^{\alpha+1} (1-x)^{-\beta+\veps}-1\bigr),
\]
and we need to check that the convergence is dominated. Notice the following, where the constant $K>0$ may vary from line to line:
\begin{itemize}
\item Since $n^{3/2} P(a,b)\left(\sfrac{a}{n}\right)^{3/2}\left(\sfrac{b}{n}\right)^{3/2}$ is uniformly bounded in $a$ and $n$, and $x<\sfrac{1}{2}$, we~have $n^{3/2}P(a,b)\leq K x^{-3/2}$.
\item Since $\Psfrac1{3}\ff(\sfrac{a}{n})\leq C(a,b)\leq 3\ff(\sfrac{a}{n})$ and $x\leq \sfrac{a}{n}\leq 2x$, we~have $\Psfrac1{3}\ff(x)\leq C(a,b)\leq 3\ff(2x)$. Since moreover $x\leq\pspfrac{a+1}{n+1}\leq 3x$, we~deduce that $C(a,b)^{\alpha+1} \left(\pspfrac{a+1}{n+1}\right)^{-\beta+\epsilon}\leq K x^{2(\alpha+1)}x^{-\beta+\veps}$, independently of the signs of $\alpha+1$ and $\beta$.
\item Similarly, we~have $|1-C(b,a)|\leq Kx^2$, and $\left|1-\pspfrac{b+1}{n+1}\right|\leq Kx$ hence $\bigl|C(b,a)^{\alpha+1}\left(\pspfrac{b+1}{n+1}\right)^{-\beta+\epsilon}-1\bigr| \leq K x$.
\end{itemize}

Combining these together yields a constant K such that
\[
|g_n(x)|\leq \frac{K}x^{-3/2}\left(x^{2\alpha+2-\beta+\veps}+x\right),
\]
which is a uniform integrable bound on $(0,1/2)$.
\end{proof}
